description.en: RTASC is a Romanian bi-modal corpus (text and speech) of read sentences, containing recordings from 6 speakers (3 males and 3 females). It was designed to serve the need of training the robot Pepper to interact with customers in the laptop department of a computer store.

full_download.title: RTASC
full_download.description: RTASC is hosted on the Zenodo platform. The latest version can be accessed using the following DOI url: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4626540
